subject: Genetics
title: Polygenic Risk Scores
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on Polygenic Risk Scores.

hook.text: No single gene predicts heart disease. But combine a million tiny effects, and you get a risk score.

buildup.text: A polygenic risk score sums thousands of genetic nudges into one number that estimates your risk for a condition.

discovery.text: Top 5% scorers for heart disease have 3x the risk compared to average.

twist.text: Scores developed in European populations perform poorly in African populations. Genetic diversity breaks the model.

climax.text: Some hospitals now use polygenic scores clinically. Others say the science isn't ready. The debate is active.

punchline.text: A million tiny genes. One number. Imperfect but powerful.

quiz.question: What does a polygenic risk score combine?
